seo.title: Donate — Support German/English/Italian courses and our work in Cameroon
seo.description: Support WAHHF Foundation: your donations fund German/English/Italian courses (A1 to C1), support for young people towards Europe and our education, health and environmental work in Cameroon.

header.title: Your donation funds German/English/Italian courses and our work in Cameroon
header.intro: The German/English/Italian courses (A1 to C1) and the support towards Europe are free of charge for young people: they are funded by our partners and our donors. Your donations also support our education, health and environmental work.

status.ready: Your message is ready: send it by WhatsApp or by email.

handoff.title: Last step: send your donation message
handoff.text: Your message asks the foundation how to pay your donation of <v>{{amount}}</v>. No payment is requested on this website.

officialChannels: For your safety, the foundation only replies by WhatsApp from <tel>{{phone}}</tel> or by email from <mail>{{email}}</mail>. If anyone writes to you from another number or another address about your donation, do not pay anything and let us know.

section.title: How to donate today
section.subtitle: Online payment is not yet available on this website. Choose an amount: a message is prepared, you send it by WhatsApp or by email, and the foundation tells you how to pay your donation.
